hash_scope: All regular workspace files except installed environments, unused Data subtrees, and archive/video files; all UR_dual_2596 dataset files and all original code/config/checkpoint/result/cache files outside those exceptions are hashed.
access_times_intentionally_not_compared: Reading may update atime; content, size, mode, ownership, mtime, ctime, inode and symlink target are preserved.
sandbox_mount_limit: Managed read-only mount roots have per-tool-invocation mtime/ctime/device. Final comparison reports changes in these surface fields separately; hidden host-side contents are not claimed inventoried.

_publication.role: portable publication copy of original experiment artifact
transformations: portable path display; original artifact hashes still describe the original run
